vehicles.duplicates.intro: The system noticed these vehicle records look like the same vehicle. Open a pair to see why. If they are genuinely two different vehicles, say so and the pair is set aside. Joining two records into one is a separate decision that is not available yet.
vehicles.duplicates.mergePendingDecision: Merging two vehicle records is not available yet. The rules for it are pending an Owner decision.
vehicles.duplicates.reason.makeModelYear: The make, model and year of manufacture are also the same.
vehicles.duplicates.reason.plate: One of these vehicles now carries a number plate that the other one used to carry.
vehicles.duplicates.reason.vin: The two chassis numbers differ by only one character, which usually means someone mistyped one of them.
vehicles.duplicates.scanNote: This page lists what the system has already noticed. It does not go looking for new pairs while you are reading — that happens separately, and every run is recorded.
vehicles.duplicates.title: Review duplicate vehicles
vehicles.ev.canRecord: You can record them from this vehicle.
vehicles.ev.heading: Electric drive
vehicles.ev.highVoltage: High-voltage safety warning is recorded for this vehicle.
vehicles.ev.notApplicable: This vehicle is not recorded as electric or hybrid, so there are no electric-drive details.
vehicles.ev.notRecordedYet: No electric-drive details have been recorded for this vehicle.
vehicles.ev.readFailed: The electric-drive details could not be loaded.
vehicles.ev.scopeNote: These are the details recorded on the vehicle. No battery health or range estimate is calculated here.
vehicles.history.heading: Change history
vehicles.history.noDetail: Changed; the values are not shown here.
vehicles.history.scopeNote: Changes to this vehicle’s own details. Owners, plates, odometer readings and linked vehicles each have their own tab.
vehicles.media.blocked: Vehicle photos and media are not available yet. Accepted file types, size limits and storage are pending an Owner decision, and nothing is uploaded or stored until it is made.
vehicles.media.heading: Photos and media
vehicles.odometer.caption: Odometer readings
vehicles.odometer.heading: Odometer
vehicles.odometer.note: Newest first. Readings are shown exactly as recorded, in the unit they were taken in.
vehicles.ownership.caption: Ownership history
vehicles.ownership.heading: Ownership
vehicles.ownership.kindHint: Leave blank to record a registered owner.
vehicles.ownership.note: Newest first. "In force" means the period has started and has not ended; an entry that starts later is not in force yet.
vehicles.plate.caption: Registration plate history
vehicles.plate.heading: Plates
vehicles.plate.note: Plates are shown in their normalised form, which is what search matches. Only one plate is in force at a time.
vehicles.profile.chooseAStatus: Choose at least one status to change.
vehicles.profile.frozenNote: This vehicle was merged into another record. It is kept for history and can no longer be changed.
vehicles.profile.noConcurrencyNote: If someone else edits this vehicle at the same time, the last save wins and you will not be warned.
vehicles.create.conflict: One of the values you entered is already used by another vehicle. Check the VIN and the reference number.
vehicles.profile.terminalNote: This vehicle is scrapped. You can still correct its details, but its status, plates, owners, authorised people and battery details can no longer change.
vehicles.profile.title: Vehicle
vehicles.relationships.caption: Vehicle relationships
vehicles.relationships.heading: People and organisations
vehicles.relationships.linkRoleHint: To authorise someone to act for this vehicle, use “Authorise a customer” below instead — that is where the permitted actions are chosen.
vehicles.relationships.manageNote: Authorised parties appear in this list. There is no separate list, so anyone who can add one may not always be able to see it here.
vehicles.relationships.retireConfirm: This ends the customer’s authorisation for this vehicle. The record stays in the history.
vehicles.relationships.retireHint: Leave blank to end it today.
vehicles.relationships.scopeExplainer: Only an authorised person carries a list of permitted actions. Every other role is a relationship, not a permission.
vehicles.search.caption: Vehicle search results
vehicles.search.description: Find a vehicle by VIN, plate or reference.
vehicles.search.exactMatchNote: VIN, plate and reference are matched exactly — partial values return nothing. Plate matches the current plate only.
vehicles.search.idleBody: Enter a VIN, plate or vehicle reference and choose Search. Results are not loaded until you do.
vehicles.search.needCriteria: Enter at least one search value.
vehicles.search.plateHint: Exact match, current plate only. A previous plate will not match.
vehicles.search.title: Vehicles
vehicles.search.vinHint: Exact match. Punctuation and spacing are ignored.
vehicles.vin.available: No other vehicle in your organisation uses this VIN.
vehicles.vin.checkUnavailable: The check could not run, so this VIN has not been confirmed either way.
vehicles.vin.duplicate: Another vehicle in your organisation already uses this VIN.
vehicles.vin.noAlphanumeric: A VIN must contain at least one letter or digit.
vehicles.vin.nonStandardLength: This is not the usual 17 characters. That is allowed and will be saved as entered.
vehicles.vin.tooLong: This VIN is longer than the maximum allowed.
crm.customers.addresses.countryHint: Two-letter country code, for example JO or AE. Leave it empty if you do not know it.
vehicles.plate.countryHint: Two or three letters, for example JO or UAE.
vehicles.plate.effectiveFromHint: Leave empty to start today. A future date schedules the change.
vehicles.plate.error.country: Use the two or three letter country code.
vehicles.odometer.observedAtHint: When the reading was taken, for example 2026-03-01T09:30:00Z.
vehicles.odometer.captureMethodHint: Where the reading came from. Ignored when an earlier reading is being corrected — a correction is recorded as one.
vehicles.odometer.correctionOfHint: Leave empty to record a new reading. Choosing a reading listed above records a correction to it instead; the original stays in the history.
vehicles.odometer.correctionReasonHint: Required whenever a reading is being corrected.
vehicles.odometer.error.observedAt: Give the date and time the reading was taken.
vehicles.odometer.error.correctionOf: Choose one of the readings listed above.
vehicles.odometer.error.reasonRequired: Give the reason this reading is being corrected.
vehicles.odometer.error.reasonWithoutRea: A reason belongs to a correction. Choose the reading being corrected, or clear this to record an ordinary reading.
vehicles.ev.capacityHint: Usable battery capacity in kWh. Leave empty if it is not known.
